facts.business: Raj Television Network Limited operates a portfolio of 14 satellite television channels across Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, Malayalam, and Hindi languages, offering general entertainment, movies, music, devotional, and regional programming, supported by owned uplinking infrastructure and distribution across cable, DTH, and digital platforms.

auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter on civil litigation relating to Mr. TR Madhavan involving claims of ₹30,073.48 thousand; Key Audit Matter on recoverability of long overdue receivables of ₹12.96 crores and litigation of receivables.
